Prov., Jan., 1918; pol. mag., Kalutara, Mar., 1920; dist. judge, Ratnapura, Jan., 1925; addnl. dist. judge, Avissawella, in addn., Oct., 1927; asst. sttlmt. offr., Sept., 1928; ag. pol. mag., Colombo, Apr. to June, 1930; ag. sttlmt. offr., Mar., 1931.

JANSZ, REGINALD BELFRAN.—B. 1878; cls. V Ceylon civ. serv., Nov., 1928; office asst. to asst. govt. agt., Trincomalee, Nov., 1928; attd., Colombo kach., Mar., 1934.

JARDINE, DOUGLAS JAMES, C.M.G. (1932), O.B.E. (1918).—B. 1888; ed. at Westminster and Trinity Coll., Cambridge; 2nd cls. classical trip., 1910 B.A., 1910; M.A., 1914; chief sec.'s off., Cyprus, 1910; pvt. sec. to ag. high commnr., July to Oct., 1911; asst. sec. to govt., 1912; ag. ch. asst. sec. on several occasions, 1912-16; passed in modern Greek, 1912; sec. to the admn., Somaliland, 1916; accompanied mission to Abyssinia on occasion of coronation of the Empress Zauditu (3rd cls. Star of Ethiopia), 1917; in charge H.Q. services, Somaliland Expdy. Force, 1920 (A.G.S. med. and ment. in desp.); senr. asst. sec., Nigerian secretariat, 1921; ag. dep. ch. sec., July to Nov., 1925 and June to Aug., 1926; dep. ch. sec., Tanganyika Territory, May, 1927; ag. ch. sec., June to Nov., 1927 and Apr. to Oct., 1928; ch. sec., Jan., 1929; gov't. dep. on several occasions since 1927; ag. gov't., in 1929, 1931 and 1933; gov't., North Borneo, 1933; accredited rep. to Perm't. Mandates Comsn., 1929, 1930 and 1931; joint-editor "Hand-book of Cyprus," 1913 and 1919, and author of "Mad Mullah of Somaliland," 1923.

JARDINE, ROBERT FRIER, C.M.G. (1928), O.B.E. (1926).—B. 1894; ed. Downing Coll., Cambridge; served European War in Gallipoli, Egypt and Mesopotamia; polit. offr., Mesopotamia, 1917; asst. divnl. adviser, Mosul prov., under Iraq govt., 1921; admvte. instr., Mosul prov., 1923; on sp. duty in Europe in connec. with Mosul question, 1925; admvte. instr., Sulaimani, 1925; do., Mosul prov., 1925; ditto, Basra, 1928; author "Grammar of Bahdinan Kurmanji (Kurdish)," 1922.

JARRETT, JAMES HENRY, K.C.—B. 1895; ed. Lancing Coll.; barrister-at-law, Gray's Inn; H.A.C., 1914; served European War, 1914-19; asst. dist. comnr., Uganda, 1919; seconded, judl. dept. as mag., 1922; mag., 1924; asst. atty.-gen., 1926; ag. solr. gen., May, 1927 to Jan., 1928; crown coun., 1927; atty.-gen., Grenada, 1929; ag. admvtr. and ag. ch. just., St. Vincent in 1930 and 1931; atty.-gen., Bahamas, 1933; ag. ch. just. and O.A.G., 1934; dep. gov., 1935; col. sec., Aug., 1935.

JARRETT, NORMAN ROWLSTONE.—B. 1889; ed. Highgate and Exeter Coll., Oxford, 3rd cls. class. mods., 1910, 2nd cls. lit. hum., 1912; B.A., 1912; cadet, F.M.S., 1912; passed cadet, July, 1914; offr., cls. V, Feb., 1916; cls. IV, Jan., 1920; dist. offr., Mar., 1921; offr., cls. III, Jan., 1925; offr., cls. II, 1930; asst. sec. to govt., F.M.S., Apr., 1930; ag. sec. to res., Pemk, May, 1931; ag. Br. advr., Trengganu, June, 1933; offr., cls. I B, 1934; ag. under sec. to govt., F.M.S., Feb., 1934.

JARVIS, CYRIL CHESTER.—B. 1884; ed. Victoria Coll., Stellenbosch; Rhodes schol., 1904; Wadham Coll., Oxford, B.A. (hon. juris.); LL.B., Cape Univ.; sec. ch. just., Cape Colony, 1907; admitted Cape bar, 1910; ch. clk. to atty.-gen., O.F.S.; prof. asst. to atty.-gen., Cape Prov., 1921; crown pros., Johannesburg, 1926; atty.-gen., Natal, 1933.

JAYARATNE, MERENNA FRANCIS DE SILVA, B.A. (Lond.).—B. 1904; cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., Feb., 1927; attd. Colombo kach., Mar., 1927; office asst., Matale kach., Jan., 1928; pol. mag.,
Jaffna, Mar., 1930; office asst., Batticaloa kach., Mar., 1933; asst. govt. agt., Mullaitivu, Oct., 1934.

JEFF, CAPT. JOHN.—B. 1896; ed. Glasgow Univ.; cadet, F.M.S., attd. Chinese prot., Ipoh, Apr., 1920; passed cadet, Dec., 1922; asst. prot., Chinese, Seremban, Dec., 1923; attd., cust. dept., Jan., 1925; offr., cls. IV., Apr., 1927; ag. prot., Chinese, Perak, Apr., 1928; ditto, N. Sembilan, Jan., 1930; ditto, Selangor and Pahang, May, 1931; offr., cls. III., Apr., 1932; ag. asst. sec., Chinese affs., S.S., Aug., 1933.

JEFF, RICHARD HEDLEY ALLISON.—B. 1889; jr. asst. engrnr., F.M.S. Rlys., June, 1913; dist. engrnr., grade III, head office, July, 1915; supervm. dist. engrnr., July, 1919; on sp. duty in S. India, Aug., 1919; dist. engrnr., grade II, K. Lumpur, Jan., 1920; dist. engrnr., grade I, Jan., 1924; ag. sec. to gen. man., F.M.S. Rlys., June, 1928-Aug., 1929; sr. dist. engrnr., head office, June, 1929; ditto, Johore Bahru, Feb., 1931; divnl. engrnr., F.M.S. rlys., Aug., 1932.

JEFFERY, CECIL ALBERT.—B. 1888; ed. Clyde schl., N.Z.; ent. N.Z. post and tel. dept., 1903; clk., govt. house, 1914; pvt. sec. to various ministers, 1915-26; ch. prot. sec. to prime min., 1926-35; clk., exec. coun. and sec. to cabinet, 1935; served with N.Z. expd. force.

JEFFERY, GEORGE, O.B.E. (1924), F.S.A.—Scholarship, R. Coll. of Art and Science, 1872; scholarship in architecture, R. Academy of London (1874); F.R.I.B.A., 1892; architect to Rt. Rev. Bishop in Jerusalem and the East, 1892; hon. corres. mem. of Imperial Institute of Archology of Russia, 1897; local sec. for Cyprus Society of Antiquaries; inad. of pub. wks., Cyprus, 1898; curator of ancient monuments, Cyprus, 1903; relinquished appt. July, 1919; reapptd. curator of ancient monuments, Cyprus, Feb., 1921; author of "Summary of Architectural Monuments of Cyprus," "Cyprus under an English King," "Historic Monuments of Cyprus," and of several papers on the medieval archaeology of Cyprus and Jerusalem, edr., new edition (1929) of "An attempt at a Bibliography of Cyprus."

JEFFREY, PAY COMMDR. A., R.D., R.N.R.—B. 1892; ed. Glas. Univ.; R.N., 1914-19; probationer, N. Rhodesia, 1919; J.P., 1920; clk. of ct. and under-sheriff, Batoka dist., 1920; asst. nat. commr., 1921; nat. commr., 1926; passed higher Chinyanga; asst. dist. offr., Tanganyika Territory 1927; asst. secy., Jan., 1930; ag. asst. ch. sec., 1934-35; clk., exec. and leg. coun., 1935; admstive. offr., 1st gr., Zanzibar, Aug., 1935; asst. sec. and clk., leg. coun., Aug., 1935.

JEFFREYS, ROBERT SYDNEY.—B. 1888; ed. Cape Town (S. Africa), Bedford Schl. and St. John's Coll., Cambridge, B.A., LL.B. (1909), Barrister-at-Law (Gray's Inn, 1910); joined adminstr., of N. Rhodesia, June, 1914; asst. native commr., and J.P., July, 1916; resigned to proceed on active serv., Feb., 1918; rejoined N. Rhodesia adminstr., May, 1919; native commr., July 1921; seconded to secretariat, Nov., 1921-Dec., 1922; asst. mag., Apr., 1926; dist. offr. (grade II) with powers of mag., Apr., 1928; seconded as asst. to sec. for native affrs., Mar., 1927-Oct., 1928; ag. crown coun., Nov., 1928-Mar., 1929; ag. pol. mag., May, 1930.

JEFFRIES, CHARLES J., O.B.E. (1928).—B. 1896; ed. Malvern Coll.; class. demy., Magdalen Coll., Oxford, 1914; 2nd lieut., 3rd Wiltshire Regt., Sept., 1915; served in France, 1916; lieut., 1917; invalided from army, Nov., 1917; tempy. 2nd cls. clk., C.O., 27th Dec., 1917; apptd. under reconstruction scheme, 2nd cls. clk., 16th July, 1919; sec., E. Africa land slmt. selection board, 1919; asst. sec., E. African currency board; prin., 1st Apr., 1920; hon. sec., Corona Club, since 1921; sec., comttee. on governors' pensions, 1927-28; asst. sec., 1st Oct., 1930.

JEFFRIES, CHARLES WILLIAM, F.R.A.S.—B. 1882; Computer, Royal Observatory, Greenwich, 1897; junr. asst., Royal Observatory, Cape of Good Hope, 1903; 1st asst., Royal Observatory, Hong Kong, 1907; chief asst., ditto, 1912; ag. dir. in 1915, 1920, 1924, 1925 and 1929; dir., 1932.

JERKILL, LIEUT.-COL. SIR HERBERT, K.C.M.G. (1901), R.E., C.M.G. (1885)—B. 1846; lieut.-R.E., Apr., 1866; employed under War Office and Trinity House in 1868 to 1870, and destruction of sunken ships, from submarine mining, and under G.P.O. in the telegraph dept., from 1870 to 1873, and 1874 to 1876; served in the campaign of 1873-74 on the G. Coast; priv. sec. to the Earl of Carnarvon, Jan., 1877, to Feb., 1878; sec. to the col. defence comttee., 1878; sec. to the roy. comn. on the defence of Br. possessions and commerce abroad, 1879-82; specially employed to visit and report on the defences of Singapore and Colombo, 1883-4; sec. col. defence comttee., 1885; priv. sec. to Lord Carnarvon, viceroy of Ireland, June, 1885, to Jan., 1886; sec. to roy. comn. for Melbourne centennial exhib., 1888; priv. sec. to lord-lieut. of Ireland, 1892-5; sec. to the roy. comn. for the Paris exhibition, 1900.

JELF, SIR ARTHUR SELBORNE, Kt. Bach. (1932), C.M.G. (1927).—B. 1876; ed. Marlborough and Exeter Coll., Oxford (extrh.); 2nd cls. class. mods., 1897; 3rd cls. lit. hum., 1899; B.A., 1899; M.A., 1913; cadet, F.M.S. civ. serv., 1899; held various admstive. and exec. posts in Malay States, 1900-10; asst. gen. adviser to Johore govt. Jan., 1911; offr. of cls. IV., Jan., 1912; chmn., man. bd., Kinta, Perak, Apr., 1914 to Apr., 1917; 2nd lieut., M.S.V.R., Sep., 1914; lieut., M.S.V.R., Jan., 1915; seconded for mil. serv. (lieut., general list), Apr., 1917; offr. of cls. III., Dec., 1917; tempy. capt., gen. staff, S. Stlttna command; attchd. gen. staff, W.O. (milit.int.l.), Jan., 1918; H.M. Petroleum Exec. (sec. to Lord Harcourt's comttee.), June, 1918; offr., cls. II., June, 1919; ag. under sec. to govt., F.M.S., June, 1920; dir., Malayan polit. intell. bureau, cls. I.B., Dec., 1921; mem., Br. Malaya opium comttee., Dec., 1923; pres., estates health comn., Apr., 1924 (reed. thanks of S. of S.).; col. sec., Jamaica, Oct., 1925; ag. gov., for various periods 1925-32; lieut.-col. local forces, Oct., 1927; ret. 1935.

JENKINS, EDWARD ENOCH.—B. 1895; ed. Peterhouse, Cambridge, B.A., LL.B., 1922; M.A., 1927; called to bar, Gray's Inn, May, 1924; joined South Wales circuit; war serv. (France) 1914-19; lieut., R.F.A.; cadet, Nyassaland, Sept., 1925; ag. atty.-gen., Apr.-July, 1927; ag. asst. atty.-gen. July-Oct., 1927; asst. regt., high ct., N. Rhodesia, Nov., 1927; crown coun., Apr., 1930; ag. solr.-gen. or ag. atty.-gen., 1931-35; ag. judge, high ct., 1934.

JENKS, J. C. A.—Ed. Bristol Gram. Schl. and Angers, France; awarded Croix-de-Guerre (Palm) 1917; Order of Saint Stanislaus with Swords (2nd cls.), and med. in desps., 1919; colonial audt. serv., 1920; asst. audr., Kenya Colony, Apr., 1920; asst. audr. in charge, Zanzibar, Nov., 1923; senr. asst. audr. in charge, Jan., 1925;
mem., retrenchment and rev. comtee., Zanzibar, 1927; Order of Brilliant Star of Zanzibar (5th cls.), 1928; senr. asst. audr. in charge, Kenya and Uganda rly. and harbors, 1929; audr., Mauritius, 1933.

JENNER, FRANK.—B. 1878; served in Cape Mounted Rifles, Bechuanaland campaign, 1896-97; S. African war, 1899-1901; sub-inspr., Basutoland Mounted Pol., 1901; inspr., 1910; supt., leper distnt., 1914; comntr., 1920.

JENNINGS, F. G.—Asst. dist. comntr., E.A.P., Apr., 1919.

JENNINGS, PRUDENTIAL HENRY.—B. 1903; ed. Christ's Hosp.; coll. audit dept., 1926; asst. audr., N. Rhodesia, 1927; asst. audr., Mauritius, 1931; ag. audr., 1932.

JEPSON, FRANK PRICE.—B. 1885; M.A., Pembroke Coll., Camb.; exhibr., medallist, and dip. in agri. (hons. in entomology), Wye Agrio. Coll., Kent, 1906; trop. disease research fund student in med. entomology, Camb. Univ., 1907; assisted in investg. by L.G.B.O. on flies as carriers of infection, 1908 and 1909; govt. entomologist, Fiji, 1909; offl. visits to Hawaii, 1911, Samoa, 1912, Java, 1913; asst. entomologist, Ceylon, 1919; ag. entomologist in addn., July, 1923 to Mar., 1924 and Oct. to Nov., 1925; del. to Imp. Agr. Research Conf., Lond., 1927; on sp. serv., U.S.A. (termite investg.), 1928.

JERMYN, LANCASTER AMBROSE SCUDAMORE, B.A.(Oxon.), M.R.S.T.—B. 1886; ed. Trin. Coll., Glenalmond and Keble Coll., Oxford; headmast. Malay Coll., K. Kangsar, F.M.S., Oct., 1919; do., Northam rd. Eng. Schl., Penang, Jan., 1923; do., govt. Eng. Schl., B. Pahat, Johore, Feb., 1926 and Mar., 1931; do., Anderson Schl., Ipoh, July, 1930; do., High Schl., Malacca, Sept., 1934.

JERRAM, JAMES HAVELOCK.—B. 1879; ed. Thames High Schl. and Auckland Gram. Schl., N.Z.; ent. N.Z. state fire insurance office, 1905; acct., 1906; dep. gen. man., 1908; gen. man., 1923.

JESSE, WILLIAM.—B. 1895; ed. Marlborough Coll.; served Indian Army R. of O., 1916-19; Afghan campaign, 1919; Calcutta Light Horse, 1921-22; apptd. treas., Kenya, 1924; asst. treas., Uganda, Jan., 1925; asst. currency offr., Uganda, 1927-28 and 1933; asst. treas., Zanzibar, Nov., 1935.

JEWELL, MORTON, M.B.E. (1931).—B. 1890; apptd., after compet. exam., clk. of the 2nd div. of the civ. ser., and assigned to the C.O., Apr., 1899; conf. clk., 1911; deptl. asst., 1st Apr., 1922; staff offr., establishments, 1st June, 1928.

JINADASA, HETTIARACHCHIGE, B.Sc. (hons.) Lond.—B. 1910; cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., Dec., 1934; attd. Puttalam kach., Jan., 1935.

JOBLING, GEOFFREY LIONEL.—B. 1899; ed. Bowen Schl., Brisbane; called to bar, Jan., 1926 (Gray's Inn); served German S.W. Africa, 1914-15; R.A.F., 1918-19; law dept., B.S.A. Co., N. Rhodesia, Nov., 1915; asst. regisr., high ct., N. Rhodesia; asst. offl. recr. in bankey., asst. admin. gen., asst. regisr., lands and deeds, asst. regisr. births, deaths and marriages, asst. regisr. companies, asst. custodian enemy property, asst. contr. local clearing office, asst. regisr., high ct., etc., Uganda, June, 1927; crown coun., Tanganyika Territory, Aug., 1929; ag. solr.-gen. in 1933 and 1934.

JOHN, SAMUEL SPEDDING.—B. 1891; barrister-at-law, Four Courts, Dublin, 1914; war serv., 1914-20; admivte. serv., Nigeria, Jan., 1921; asst. judge, high ct., 1934.

JOHNS, BRIAN MAURICE, M.B., Ch.B. (N.Z.), F.R.C.S. (Ed.), D.T.M. & H. (Eng.).—B. 1901; med. offr., S.S., Mar., 1923; prof. clin. surgery., King Edward VII Coll. of Med., Spore, Aug., 1928.

JOHNS, ROBERT.—B. 1903; ed. Monmouthshire Agr. Inst., Usk, and Univ. Coll. of Wales, Aberystwyth; imp. Coll. Trop. Agr., Trinidad; N.D.A., O.D.A., C.D.D., A.I.C.T.A.; stock inspir., Tanganyika, 1926; C.O. agr. research scholar, Trinidad, and Univ. of Reading, 1929-30; agr. offr., Zanzibar, 1931.

JOHNSON, CHARLES WALTER TREVOR.—B. 1893; Fiji serv., 1910; col. sec.'s office, 1915; lst cls. clk. and clk. to exec. and leg. couns., 1920; ag. pvt. sec. to ag. gov. on three occasions; seconded for serv. in W. Pacific high comn. as dist. offr., Fanning Island, Feb.-Nov., 1923; ch. clk., secretariat, 1927; ag. prov. and dist. comntr., June-Sept., 1928; ag. asst. col. sec., Nov., 1929; 2nd asst. col. sec., 1931; ag. 1st asst. col. sec. in 1932, 1933 and 1934; ag. prin. asst. col. sec. in 1934 and 1935; mem., Fiji mining bd. and mem., advy. bd., cent. med. schl.

JOHNSON, E. T.—B. 1875; ed. Sedbergh Schl. and Trinity Hall (Camb.); B.A., LL.B. (Law Tripos, 1902); res. mag., K. Africa Prot., 1915; senr. res. mag., Kenya, Dec., 1922; ag. judge, in 1924-25 and 1928-29; puisne judge, Zanzibar, 1929; ag. ch. just., 1932; judge, Nyasaland Prot., 1934.

JOHNSON, ELLEN M., M.B.E. (1930).—B. 1873; asst. clk., post office, Sept., 1914; ch. clk., Jan., 1924; ag. postmr. in 1925 and 1930; asst. postmr., June, 1926; ag. postmr., Aug. to Sept., 1932.

JOHNSON, FREDERICK ENGLAND, I.S.O. (1932), A.F.I.A. (Australia).—B. 1878; served in S. African war, 1899-1901 (Queen's medal, 3 clasps); inspir. of native labourers, British residency, New Hebrides, 1908; in charge of acots. of British residency, 1909; ag. comdt. of British div. of native constab., 1908, 1910, 1912, and from 1914, in addition to other duties; is also a dep. comntr. of the high comntr.'s ct. for the W. Pacific, and ag. regisr. of high comntr.'s ct., in the New Hebrides; treas. and collr. of cust., Br. Solomon Is., Nov., 1919; offl. mem., advisory coun., 1927.

JOHNSON, CAPT. GEORGE BENJAMIN, M.R.S.T.—B. 1884; ed. Ryder's Schl., Devonport and Cheltenham Training Coll. (dipl. educn.); Leicestershire Regt. and gen. staff, 1915-19; ag. vice-consul, Le Havre, 1920; headmr., Zanzibar educn. dept., 1920; ditto and inspir., schl., 1925; ch. inspir., schl., 1928; ag. dir., educn. for various periods, 1920-33; temp. mem., L.C., 1928, 1930, 1932-33; temp. mem., E.C., 1932-33.

JOHNSON, JOHN-COLEMAN DE GRAFT, O.B.E (1935).—B. 1884; ed. Wesleyan Coll. Schl., Cape Coast; 5th grade clk., Ashanti, 1907; 4th grade clk., police dept., 1912; asst. inspir., W. and M., 1914; asst. sec. for native affrs. Mar., 1920; mem., Accra town coun., Jan., 1928.

JOHNSON, SIR WALTER BURFORD, Kt. Bach. (1935), L.R.C.P., M.B., B.S. (Lond.), F.R.C.S. (Eng.).—B. 1885; ed. City of London Schl. and St. Thomas's Hosp.; med. offr., N. Nigeria, 1912; seconded for sp. investg. work under yellow fever comn., Sierra Leone, Oct., 1913 to May, 1914; temp. capt., gen. list, 1914-15; tsetse investigator, 1921; specialist, 1921; seconded for serv. on Tsetse fly comn.; dir., med. and sanv. services, Nigeria, Mar., 1929.

JOHNSON, HON. SIR WILLIAM ELLIOT, K.C.M.G. (1920).—B.1862; speaker of the H. of R., C. of A., 1913-14 and 1917-23; ret. from politics.
JOHNSON, WILLIAM JOSEPH, O.B.E. (1927).—B. 1892; serv. in L.E.F., E. Africa, 1914-17; ment. in desps., 1917; transf'd. to depot, 11th Mahars, India, 1917; offr. in charge, clearing house, office of field contr. of mil'y. acts., E.E.F., Cairo, 1918; major, ch. acts. offr., O.E.T. admtn., Palestine, 1919; treas., Palestine civ. admtn., July, 1920; dep. treas. on abolition of post of finan. sec., May, 1922; ag. treas. and mem. exec. and advisory couns. for various periods, 1923-28; mem., comttee. on pub. security forces, 1923; mem., comttee. on establishment of permanent and pensionable cadre for gen. clerical serv., 1925; mem., road bd., 1926; mem., rly. bd., 1928; currency offr., Jan.-June, 1928; treas. and currency offr., 1932; chmn. income tax comttee., 1934; head, trade delegn. to Egypt, 1935.

JOHNSTON, H. LINDSAY.—Govt. statist., S. Australia, 1916.

JOHNSTON, Hon. Harold Featherston, K.C. (1930), B.A. (Oxford).—B. 1875; ed. Wanganui Coll., N.Z. and Trinity Coll., Oxford; barrister-at-law, Lincoln's Inn (1897) and N.Z.(1898); many years legal practice; pres., Wellington dist. law soc., 1928; judge, N.Z. sup. ct., 1934; judge ct. of review of mortgagors' liabilities, 1935; served in France with London Scottish (1916-18).

JOHNSTON, JOHN ROKE.—B. 1898; ed. St. Ninians, Moffat and St. Bees Schls. and Sandhurst; 2nd lieut., The Black Watch, 23rd Dec., 1917; seconded to 2/1st K.A.R., 23rd Dec., 1920; adminis. offr., Tanganyika Territory, 12th Sept., 1923.

JOHNSTON, Sir REGINALD FLEMING, K.C.M.G. (1930), C.M.G. (1928), C.B.E. (1918).—B. 1874; M.A. Magdalen Coll., Oxford (1901), Gray prizeman, Edin. Univ., 1894; prox. acc. Lord Rector's essay, Edin.; hon. in English lit., nod. hist. and constitutional law, Edin.; exhib., Magd. Coll., Oxford, 1894; ment., hon. causa Stanhope Essay, 1898; B.A., 1898; cadet, Hong Kong, 1898; ag. clk. of couns., 1899; pvt. sec. to gov't., 1900-01; ag. ast. col. sec., 1900-04; J.P., June, 1902; sec. to gov't., Weihaiwei, 1904; dist. offr. and mag., ditto, 1906; seconded for serv. as tutor to Manchu Emperor (ex-Emperor of China), 1919-26; recd. from Emperor button of highest offl. grade and sable robe, 1922; warden, Summer Palace, Peking, 1924; brought Emperor into safety in legation quarter, Peking, Nov., 1924; sec., Br. China indemnity delegation, 1926; comsrr., Weihaiwei, 1927-30.

JOHNSTON, WILLIAM—B. 1890; ast. clk., G.P.O., May, 1910; offr., cust. and excise, Aug., 1911; dep. collr., cust., Mauritius, Dec., 1920; sec., harbr. bd., 1922-25; chmn., ditto, 1923-24; sec., tariff advisory bd., 1927-31; chmn., ditto, on various occasions, 1927-30; comsrr. of excise for tobacco in addn., 1927-31 and ag. ast. supt., inland rev., May to July, 1929; ag. collr., cust. and harbrmr., M.I.C., on various occasions, 1923-30; collr.-gen., Jamaica, Jan., 1932; col. sec., treas. and collr., cust., Br. Honduras, 1935.

JOHNSTONE, ANGUS COLIN DUNCAN.—B. 1889; ed. Trin. Coll., Glenalmond, and in Germany; passed Army entrance exam., R.M.C., Sandhurst, 1908; higher grade staff, G. Cent. Rly., 1909-12; served, Balkan War, with Br. Red Cross Unit attd. Turkish Forces, 1912-13; lieut., 5th (Res.) Batt. West Yorks Regt. (T.), Nov., 1914 to Apr., 1915; ast. dist. comsrr., Gold Coast, 10th Sept., 1913; lieut., W.A.F.F., and attd. Gold Coast Regt., Apr., 1915; seconded Br. Forces, Togoland, May, 1915; offr., cls. II., polit. serv., Jan., 1920; dist. comsrr., Ashanti Akim, Sept., 1922; prov. comsrr., Apr., 1928; comsrr., S. Prov., Aug., 1929; ag. ch. comsrr., N. Territories in addn., Dec., 1929 to Jan., 1930.

JOHNSTONE, JAMES MONTAGU CHOLMELEY.—Ent. prison dept. (England and Wales), Aug., 1921; dep. ast. supt., prisons, Trinidad, 1924; ast. supt., 1927.

JOHNSTONE, SIR ROBERT STEWART, KT. BACH. (1915).—Ed. at Trin. Coll., Dublin; B.A. (honors and medal in history and political science), 1882; LL.B., 1884; M.A., 1895; Holt scholar, Gray's Inn, 1885; called to the Irish bar 1886; called to the bar at Gray's Inn, Jan., 1889; lieut., 3rd (Militia) Batt. Manchester Regt., 1883; capt., 1887; dist. comsrr., Lagos, 1889; served on Lagos and Porto Novo boundary comttee., 1890; stip. and circuit mag. and judge of ct. of com. pleas., Bahamas, Jan., 1894; ag. attv.-gen., Aug. to Nov., 1902; ch. just., Grenada, 1909; ret., 1914.

JOMARON, ADOLPHE CHARLES.—B. 1893; ed. at University Coll. Schl. and Corpus Christi Coll., Camb. (class. schol.)—B.A. 1920; 2nd lieut., R.F.A., 1914; lieut., 1915; capt., 1917; ag. major, 1918; cadet, F.M.S., Nov., 1920, attd. to ast. advisor's office, Muar, Johore; 2nd ast. advisor, Muar, Johore, Jan., 1922; offr., cls. LAWRENCE, MAJOR CHARLES TREVOR, O.B.E. (1926)—B. 1876; ed. St. David's, Reigate and at Shrewsbury Sch.; N. Nigeria Regt., 1900-05; A.D.C. to Gov., S. Nigeria, 1906; junr. asst. sec., S. Empire Exhibn., 1923; ag. lieut.-gov'r., S. Prov., 1927; staff grade, 1928; admstr. of col., 1930.

LAWSON, HON. SIR HARRY SUTHERLAND WIGHTMAN, K.C.M.G. (1933).—B. 1875; M.L.A. for Castlemaine, Victoria, 1899; sat continuously in State Parlmt. from 1899; comanr. of crown lands and survey, Dec., 1913 to Nov., 1915; afterwards atty.-gen., solr. gen. and min. of public instrn., premier and atty.-gen. 1918; premier and min. of agr., 1920-24; now C'wealth senator for Victoria.

LAWSON, R. A.—Asst. traffic man., Uganda rly., Apr., 1919.

LEA, LESLIE.—Ed. privately and Univ. Coll. Schl., Gray's Inn, 1922; clk. acct., fencing dept., E. Africa Prot., Sept., 1908; conf. clk. to comanr. for lands, 1909; conveyancing clk., land dept., 1910; ag. conveyancer, 1913; asst. registr., crown lands, 1916; musketry instr., K.A.R., 1916 (recd. thanks G.O.C.L. of C.); registr. of titles, 1919; dep. recorder of titles, 1919; ag. prin. registr., crown lands, 1920; dep. registr.-gen., titles and ch. controlling rev. authority, 1920-21; law offr., legal adviser, etc., St. Helena, Aug., 1923; col. audlr., mem., bl. of comanrs., crown property, Sept., 1923; offr.-in-charge, secretariat, 1925; comanr. for preparation of new edn. of laws, 1925.

LEA, WALTER ALBERT, A.M.I.C.E.—B. 1883; ed. at Carpenters' Company's Coll. and West Ham Tech. Inst.; dist. engnr., Br. Guiana, Dec., 1914; exec. engnr., P.W.D., Tanganyika Territory, 1929.

LEACH, FRANK, M.C., B.A. (Oxon).—B. 1889; on mil'y serv., July, 1917; cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., May, 1921; attd., secretariat, June, 1921; office asst. to asst. gov't. agt., Hambantota, Nov., 1922; asst. sttlmt. offr., Oct., 1923; office asst. to dir., med. and sani. services, Apr., 1929; asst. sttlmt. offr., Jan., 1930; asst. gov't. agt., Badulla, Feb., 1931; do., Hambantota, Apr., 1932.

LEADBETTER, SIDNEY.—B. 1902; apptd. after compet. exam., cler. offr., C.O., 4th May, 1920.

U.S. forest serv. as student, 1903; apptd. forest asst., 1904, with successive appts. as ch. of boundaries, asst. ch., office of organization, ch., office of organization, dist. forester, and asst. forester; ch. forester, comanr. of conservn. and bl. of rly. comanrs., Canada, 1912; ch. fire inspr., bd. of rly. comanrs., 1921; mem., soc. of American Foresters; successively, pres. and sec., Can. Soc. of Forest Engnr.

LECHMEREGUPPY, GARRETH EVERARD.—B. 1874; entd. civ. ser., Trinidad, May, 1895; seconded for special serv. to water authority and sewerage bd., 1904-1905; ag. inspr. of imgrts. in 1909, 1910, 1912 to 1913; statistical clk. and librnr., col. secretariat, Trinidad, July, 1915; sec. income tax comttee., estd. comttee., tenders comttee., and civ. serv. comttee.; J.P. for the col. and Tobago; dep. sub-intendant crown lands, Dec., 1920; sub.-intend., crown lands, Jan., 1925.

LECHMEREGUPPY, P. (Junn.).—Super-numerary clk., audit offr., Trinidad, 1889; 4th clk., sub-treasy., San Fernando, Jan., 1892; landing waiter, customs, May, 1894; clk., col. treasy., Mar., 1898; acted as warden, Tacarigua, in 1902, 1904 and 1905; sub-recr., postmaster, collr. of cust. and harbr. mat., Tobago, Oct., 1917; collected fresh-water nipa of Trinidad for British Museum.
LECK, W. J., M.I.M.E.—B. 1889; ed. St. Bees Schl., Cumberland; colliery man, Nigeria, 1914.

LECKIE, Capt. Peter Martin, L.S.(Vict.) B. 1890; survr., dept. lands and surveys, Dec., 1907; staff survr., May, 1913; war survr., Sept., 1915-18; survr., Perak, F.M.S., Oct., 1920; do., Kedah, Apr., 1925; asst. supt., surveys, Jan., 1926; do., S'pore, Mar., 1929; do., Kelantan, May, 1932.

LE CONTE, LOUIS.—B. 1881; mag., lesser dependencies, Mauritius, 1909; do., Mauritius and Rodrigues, Oct., 1913; ag. mast. and regisr., sup. ct., 1913-14; ag. prot. of immigrts. and poor law consnr., 1914; war survr. in France and Macedonia, 1916-19; food survr., May, 1920; puisne judge, July, 1932; ag. ch. judge, sup. ct., Oct., 1933.

LEDEBOER, CLAUD MARIUS.—Served in S. African Constab., 1901-7 (S.A. war med.); Bech. Prot. police, from 1907; sub-insp. Bech. Prot. police, 1st Apr., 1914; asst. res. mag.; passed Cape civ. surv. lower law exam. and 2nd grade Sechuana exam.; 2nd lieut., gen. list, 1919; ag. res. mag., 1921; res. mag., 1921; passed Cape civ. surv. higher law exam., 1923; ag. asst. res. comantr., 1930.

LEE, FRANK G.—B. 1903; ed. Brentwood Schl. and Downing Coll., Cambridge; 1st cls. English tripus, 1923; 1st cls. historical tripus, part II, 1924; foundation schl., 1924; apptd. to C.O. after compet. exam., 8th Nov., 1926; temp. ag. prin., 26th Sept., 1930; seconded to Nyasaland adminstr., 2nd Apr., 1931; asst. pvtv. sec. to S. of S. for theCols., 4th Aug., 1933.

LEE, HARRIE BERTIK, D.S.O., M.C., M.B., B.S. (hons.) Melbourne, D.T.M. and H., Eng.; certif. London S.T.M. (with distinc.), B. 1888; ed. Sydney and Melbourne Univ.; four years serv. with A.I.F. in field as R.M.O.; field ambulance offr. and D.A.D.M.S., 1st Australian Divn., 1914-18; med. offr., W.A.M.S., Nigeria, Jan., 1924; specialist, Nigeria, Aug., 1933.

LEE, JOHN HENRY BURKILL.—B. 1905; ed. Univ. Coll., Leicester; cadet, Hong Kong, civ. surv., Dec., 1928; asst. treas., Apr., 1931; asst. P.M.G., 1932; 1st clk. and pol. mag., Kowloon, Feb., 1934; asst. dist. offr., North, Jan., 1935; pvtv. sec. to O.A.G., May, 1935.

LEE, LIONEL JAMES, A.M.I.M.E.—Ed. R.N.E. Coll., Keyham; asst. engrnr., marine dept., Nigeria, 1913; prin. engrnr., 1927; supt. engrnr., June, 1933.

LEE, HON. SIR W. H., K.C.M.G. (1922), Kt. BACH (1920).—M.H.A., Tasmania; premier, chief sec., and min. for educn., 1916-22.

LEEMBRUGGEN, EDWARD LEELE.—B. 1893; regisr. clk., Western Pacific high comsnr., 1917; corres. clk., Gilbert and Ellice Is. Col., 1920; sec. to res. comsnr., 1922; sec. to govt., 1931.

LEES, ABBEY TREVOR OSWALD.—B. 1899; ed. Repton and Royal Milly Academy, Woolwich; ent. R. Arty., Jan., 1919; served with 2nd R.W. LEESE, CHARLES WILLIAM, C.M.G. (1932).—Asst. dist. comsnr., S. Nigeria, Sept., 1906; transf'd. to treasy. dept., 1907; acted as supervisor of customs, 1908, and as junior asst. sec. in 1911; served as finan. offr., Cameroons Expedy. Force, 1916; dep. treas., 1921; ag. treas., May to Dec., 1921; and June to Dec., 1923; treas., G. Coast, 1924; ag. col. sec., Sept.-Nov., 1925 and from Oct., 1926 to Mar., 1927; gov.'s offr. on various occasions in 1926 and 1927; treas., Nigeria, Oct., 1928.

LEGGE, CHARLES ARTHUR LIONEL.—B. 1879; clerical astt., B. Guiana, May, 1897; 6th class offr., cust., June, 1899; 5th class clk., pol. dept., Dec., 1900; lieut., B. G. Artillery, 1901; attached to No. 32 Coy. R.G.A., Portsmouth, July, 1904; cert. in depression range finding, July, 1904; Hythe musk. cert., Aug., 1904; sub-inspr. of pol. and excise, Grenada, Oct., 1904; promoted captn., B. Guiana Artillery, and seconded, Dec., 1904; mem. local health authority, St. Andrew's parish, Grenada, Jan., 1905; ag. ch. of pol., Grenada, from June, 1907.

LEGGE, CYRIL HENRY ETHERWOOD.—B. 1883; joined B. Hindi exam.

LEIGH-CLARE, HARRY JAMES LEIGH.—B. 1891; on milv. serv., Jan., 1915; cadet, Ceylon, Feb., 1920; attd., Colombo kach., Mar., 1920; attd. office of food contrlr., Apr., 1920; ag. office astt. to govt. agt., S. LEMAIRE, ERNEST JOSEPH, C.M.G. (1934).—B. 1874; ed. Sherbrooke (Que.), Coll.; ent. privy coun. office for Canada, Jan., 1894; priv. sec., prime min., 1904-11; post office dept., 1912-23; clk. of privy coun. for Canada, Aug., 1923.

LEMBERGER, MAURICE.—B. 1900; apptd. after compet. exam., asst. clk., 23rd Apr., 1918; on milv. surv., 26th Aug., 1918 to 27th Feb., 1920; apptd. cler. offr., 1st Jan., 1920; trans. to P.O. stores dept., Mar., 1920; trans. to C.O., 1st Sept., 1923.

LEMPRIERE, WILLIAM HENRY.—B. 1898; ed. Victoria Coll., Jersey; enlisted K.R.R.C., 1916; 2nd lieut., Cheshire Regt., 1917; ag. capt., Sch. of Instrn., E.E.F., 1919-21; demob., 1921; col. audit dept., Oct., 1921; astt. audr., Gold Coast, Nov., 1921; senr. astt. audr., Kenya, 1933.

Africa, 1900; conf. clk., govt. comsnr.'s office, 1901; clk., Transvaal pol., 1902; ag. ch. clk., do. pol., 1903-8; supt. clk. do. pol., 1908; sub-inspr., S.A. pol., 1913; inspr. do. pol., 1918; senr. inspr., 1928; dep. comsnr., 1929; ch. dep. comsnr., 1933.

P.M.G., May to Oct., 1924 and from July-Dec., 1925; P.M.G., Apr., 1926.
LE ROUX, JONATHAN JOHAN DU PRÉ.—B. 1900; ed., B.H.S., Paarl, Univ. Capetown, Royal Coll., Edin., and Univ., Witwatersrand; L.R.C.P. & S. (Edin.), L.R.F.P.S. (Glas.), D.P.H. (Wit.), 1933; med. offr., leper inst., Pretoria, Nov., 1927; med. supt., Jan., 1933.

LESSELS, RAYMOND.—B. 1897; asst. engnr., posts and tels. dept., Nigeria, Mar., 1924; divnl. engnr., Apr., 1933; ag. engnr.-in-ch., 1932 and 1934.

LESTER, A. R., M.B., B.S. (Bomb.), F.R.F.P.S. (Glas.), D.P.H., D.T.M. and H. (Edin.)—B. 1890; Indian med. serv., 1917-22; mily. serv., India and Persia, 1918-22; med. offr., Tanganyika Territory, Feb., 1924; med. offr. in ch., sp. sociological investgn., Kahama, 1927-31; senr. med. offr., Uganda, 1934.

LETHAM, CHARLES KINGSLEY, B.Sc. (agr.)—B. 1901; ed. S. African Coll. Schl., Capetown; B.Sc. (agr.), Transvaal Univ. Coll., Pretoria; Univ. of S. Africa, 1922; dist. agrl. offr., Tanganyika Territory, 1924.

LETHEM, Sir GORDON JAMES, K.C.M.G. (1936), C.M.G. (1934).—B. 1886; ed. at Mill Hill Schl., Middlesex, and Edin. and Grenoble Univs.; M.A. and LL.B. (with distinction), Edin.; mem. of Lincoln's Inn; asst. res., N. Nigeria, Mar., 1911; res., Aug., 1924; ag. sec., N. Provs., Apr. to Nov., 1927; ag. sec., native affras., Nov., 1927 to Sept., 1928; staff grade, Mar., 1928; sec., N. Provs., Apr., 1929; gov. and commdr.-in-ch., Seychelles, 1933; do., Leeward Is., 1935.

LEVINKIND, LEOPOLD.—B. 1892; ed. S. African Coll., Cape Town; B.Se. (engnrg.); corp., C.P. Rifles, S.W. Africa campaign; ent. dept., irrig., Union of S. Africa, 1917; hydrographic surv., 1934.

LEWRY, MAJOR A.W., M.A. (Cantab.), Barrister-at-Law (Inner Temple).—Ed. St. Paul's and Trinity Hall, Cambridge; Middlesex Regt., European War, 1914-18; Gallipoli, Egypt, Flanders, Palestine, severely wounded; pol. mag., Gambia, Dec., 1929; aide-de-camp and pvt. sec., Gambia, Jan.-June, 1930; ag. legal adviser, and prov. mem., exec. and leg. couns. on several occasions; crown counsel, Kenya, Oct., 1932.

LEWIN, CLAUD JOHN, M.C., B.Sc.—B. 1898; ed. Sexey's Sch., Univ. Rhodesia, Nov., 1930; ag. sec., agr., Dec., 1932; dir., agr., July, 1933; temp. M.L.C., 1935.

LEWIS, ALFRED DALE, B.A. (Cape), M.A. (Cantab.), M.I.M.E., M.Inst.C.E. —B. 1881; P.W.D., India, 1905-07; circle engnr., irrig. dept., Cape and Union of S. LEWIS, JOHN WILLIAMSON, A.M.I.C.E.—B. 1887; ed. LEWIS, MALCOLM STUART.—B. 1889; H.A.C., 1914-16; R.G.A., 1917-19; treasy. asst., Nigeria, 1919; senr. asst. treas., 1934.

LEWIS, WILLIAM EDWIN.—B. 1886; ed. West Monmouthshire Grammar Schl.; traffic asst., Gold Coast rly., Aug., 1911; seconded for war serv., Cameroons, 1915; dist. traffic supt., Apr., 1921; traffic man., Feb., 1929.

LEWTHWAITE, RAYMOND, M.A., D.M., R.Ch. (Oxon.), M.R.C.S. (Eng.), L.R.C.P. (Lond.)—B. 1894; schol. student, Inst. Med. Resch., F.M.S., Dec., 1926; ag. pathologist I, Mar., 1928, June, 1929, and May, 1931; pathologist II, Jan., 1929; pathologist I, Dec., 1931.

LEY, MAJOR CUTHBERT HILLARY, O.B.E. late R.E., F.R.Met.Soc.—B. 1872; comen. in R. Engnr., 1892-1907; ret. from army, 1907; army serv. in Jamaica, 1896-99; S. Britain, 1912; served during war at Southampton in depts. of fortifications, miny. of munitions, and directorate of arty.; dir., Palestinesurvey, Dec., 1920.

MAUDE, HENRY EVANS.—B., 1906; ed. Highgate Schl. and Jesus Coll., Cambridge; B.A., 1929; M.A., 1933; cadet, Gilbert and Ellice Is., 1929; dep. commr., 1931; ag. native lands commr., 1931; admstr.-offr., 1932; ag. sec. to govt., Mar.-June, 1933; nat. lands commr., Gilbert Is., 1935.

MAVOR, WILLIAM DAVID.—B., 1881; ed. Heriot Watt Coll. (Edin.), foreman, photo-litho seen., F.M.S., Oct., 1910; mily. serv., Highland F. Amb., Sept., 1915; demob., Mar., 1919; asst. supt., photo-litho seen., Jan., 1921; ch. photo-litho, surv. dept., F.M.S., July, 1923.

MAVROGORDATO, COL. ARTHUR STEPHEN, O.B.E. (1928).—B., 1886; ed. at Oakham Schl., Rutland; clk., pol. headqrs., Cyprus, Nov., 1903; inspr., mil. pol., Cyprus, May, 1905; in ch., pol. detachment, Kyrena, 1907-1909; gov., prison and dep. coroner; in command of Papho dist. several occasions; detailed for sp. duty in Larnaca dist. in connection with Limassol riots, May-June, 1912; asst. commr., pol., Sierra Leone, June, 1913; J.P. and dep. coroner, 1913; ag. commr., pol., also sheriff, prison visiting just., and govt. nominee on city coun. of Freetown, and performing duties of marshal of the Adny. prize ct., on various occasions, 1915-18; ag. harbour and detaining offr., under mil. authorities, in 1916, 1917, 1918 and 1919; ag. dist. commr. in headqrs. dist., S. Leone, Feb.-Mar., 1919; dep. inspr.-gen., pol. and prisons, Palestine, Dec., 1922; ag. inspr.-gen., pol. and prisons, Apr., 1924; commdt., ditto, Apr., 1925; rep. Palestine govt. at internat. pol. confce., Antwerp, Sept., 1930; inspr.-gen., constab., Trinidad, July, 1931; mem., leg. coun.; awarded King’s Pol. med., 1934.

MAXWELL, COL. GROFFREY ARCHIBALD PRENTICE, C.M.G. (1934), D.S.O., M.V.O., M.C., Officer Ordre de Leopold, Officer Legion d’Honneur, Belgian Croix de Guerre, French Croix de Guerre, M.Inst.T.—B., 1885; R.M.A., Woolwich, 1902; R.E., 1904; Nigeria Barokanory, 1908-11; survey, E.A.P., 1912-14; European War, 1914-18 (ment. seven times in desps.); inter-allied commn. of control, rlys., occupied territory, 1919; communications sec., sup. economic coun., 1919-20; gen. man., rlys., Tanganyika territory, 1920.

MAXWELL, Sir WM. GEORGE, K.B.E. (1924), C.M.G. (1915); Royal Humane Society’s med. (1882).—B., 1871; ed. at Clifton Coll.; barrister-at-law, Inner Temp.; jun. offr., Perak, F.M.S., Mar., 1891 asst. mag., Kinta, Apr., 1892; regis. of cts., Kinta, Perak, Feb., 1899; dist. offr., Dindings, Aug., 1905; dep. pub. proc., Singapore, 1906; sol.-gen., S. Sttlmts., Aug., 1906; British adviser to govt. of Kedah, July, 1909; ag. col. sec., S. Sttlmts., 1914; ag. sec. to high commr., Malay States and Brunei, 1915; ag. British res., Perak, Dec., 1916 to May, 1917; ag. sec. to high commr., Malay States and Brunei, June, 1917; vice-chmn., food control comtees., S.S. and F.M.S.; vice-chmn., shipping control comtee., S.S.; pres., rubber comm., 1918; pres., Singapore housing comm.; pres., Singapore centenary comtee.; general adviser to govt., Johore, June, 1918; ag. col. sec., S. Sttlmts., Dec., 1918; Br. res., Perak, Dec., 1919; ch. sec. to govt., F.M.S., Sept., 1920; ret., 1926; publications, “Perak Land Laws (past and present),” “The Laws of Perak, 1877-1903,” “The Laws of the S. Sttlmts., 1827-1907,” “In Malay Forests.”

MAXWELL-ANDERSON, Sir MAXWELL HENDRY—Kt. Bach. (1934), C.B.E. (mil.) (1919); O.B.E. (1918); K.C., Aug., 1919; capt., R.N. (ret.).—Ent. Royal Navy, 1893; ret. at own request, 1912; recd. thanks of Admy. for series of magnetic observations carried out in the Pacific Ocean; inst., R.N. Pacific, 1929; ag. high commr., W. Pacific, June to Aug., 1930.

MAY, HENRY O’HARA, M.D., B.C.H., B.A.O. (Univ. Dubl.), D.P.H. (Irel.)—B., 1878; med. offr., W.A.M.S., Apr., 1907; med. offr., health, Nov., 1911; junr. sanry. offr., Aug., 1916; dep. dir., sanry. serv., Sierra Leone, Oct., 1922; dep. dir., health serv., Gold Coast, June, 1926.

MAY, THOMAS WILLIAM VIVIAN, A.R.I.B.A., M.I.Struct.E., chrted. archt.—B., 1889; asst. in prin. archt’s dept. of H.M.O.W., 1909-14; war serv., Aug., 1914-Aug., 1919; asst. archt., S’pore, Harbr. Bd., Nov. 1919; asst. archt., P.W.D., May, 1924; ag. govt. archt., S.S., Sept., 1925 and May, 1929; asst. archt., S’pore, July, 1933.

MAYHEW, ARTHUR INNES, C.I.E.—B., 1878; ed. at Winchester and New Coll., Oxford (schl.); B.A., 1901; Berlin and Jena Univs.; ent. Indian educn. serv., 1903; educn. advisor, Hyderabad State, 1910; dir. pub. instrn., Cent. MAYLE, NORMAN LESLIE.—B. 1899; apptd. after compet. exam., asst. clk., C.O., Oct., 1917; cler. offr., lat Jan., 1920; promoted to clk. of the 2nd div., Feb., 1920; on mil serv. from Sept., 1917 to Sept., 1919; cler. offr., higher grade, 7th July, 1923; asst. prin., 16th Nov., 1928; ag. pvt. sec. to parly. MAYNARD, PERCY.—B. 1903; apptd. after compet. exam., cler. offr., C.O., 15th Oct., 1920.

JOSEPH MICHAEL, B.A. (T.C.D.), Barrister-at-Law (King's Inns, Dublin).—B. 1889; European mast., S.S. and F.M.S., Dec., 1920; asst. mast., King Edward VII schl., Taiping, Feb., 1921; asst. inspr., schls., Perak, Jan., 1923, Sept., 1925 and Apr., 1929; inspr., schls., N. MEDWAY, F. W.—Imp. serv. (acctn.-gen.'s dept., G.P.O.), 1901-2; clk., G.P.O., Bloemfontein, Nov., 1902; clk., treasy., O.F.S., May, 1908; senr. clk., treasy., Union of S. MERRICK, H. F. C.—B. 1889; ed. Battersea Gram. Schl. and London Univ.; ast. audr. S.
Nigeria, 1913; ditto, Sierra Leone, 1914; audr., Malta, 1920–22; clk., col. audit dept., 1922; audr., Gibraltar, May, 1927.

MERRICK, JOHN EDWARD SIGFRID, O.B.E. (1931).—B. 1888; ed. Winchester and Univ. METZGEN, MONRAD SIGFRID, M.B.E. (1932).—B. 1893; temp. clk. to keeper of prisons, B. Hond. Handbook.

MICHAUD, HON. JOSEPH E., B.A., LL.B.—B. 1888; ed. Quebec Seminary, Laval Univ. (B.A. 1910), St. Dunstan Univ., Charlottetown, P.E.I., Dalhousie Law Schl. MORT, ERIC LAIDLFT, O.B.E. (1935), B.A.—Ed. Tonbridge Schl. and University Coll., Oxford; jur. supt., educn. dept., N. Nigeria, Aug., 1914; attched. Nigeria Regt., 1916, and 1917-18; supt., educn., Nigeria, Jan., 1920; ag. ch. inspr., N. Provs., 1935.

MORTEN, FREDERICK JOSEPH—B. 1888; ed. Lancing Coll. and Exeter Coll., Oxford; B.A., 1911; cadet, S.S., Dec., 1912; ag. 4th mag. and asst. dist. judge, Singapore, Mar., 1913; ag. dist. offr., Jasir, Jan., 1914; passed cadet, Jan., 1915; ag. dist. offr., Alor Gajah, Sept., 1915; attached to col. sec. Jan., 1919; ag. asst. to res., Malacca, and agent to food contrlr., in addition, Jan., 1920; asst. treas. and collr. of stamps, Malacca, in addn., June, 1921; ag. sheffir and regis., sup. ct., Penang, Mar., 1924; ag. 1st asst., sec. B, and clk. of couns., Nov., 1924; ag. under sec., S.S., Feb., 1928; ag. 1st asst., sec. B, and clk. of couns., Feb., 1928; ag. 1st asst., sec. A, Dec., 1928; ag. under sec., S.S., Oct., 1929 and Dec., 1930; ag. dist. offr., P.W.; cls. II, Dec., 1929; ag. dir., educn., S.S. and F.M.S., cls. IA, Apr., 1932.

MORTON, JOHN, M.R.C.V.S. (1927).—B. 1901; ed. Keil Schl. and Glasgow Vety. Coll.; Fraser research schol. at Rowett Research Inst., Aberdeen, 1927-28; Scottish bd. of agr. research schol., 1928-29; vety. offr., Falkland Is., Apr., 1929; lieut., Falkland Is. Defence Force, 1929; vety. offr., Nigeria, 1933.

MOSELEY, FRANCIS ARNOLD.—B. 1883; ed. Perth, W. Australia and Brasenose Coll., Oxon.; B.A. 1904; called to bar, Middle Temp., May, 1905; judge's associate and clk. of arraigns, W. Aust., Oct., 1905; mily. serv., Australia, 1915-16; France, 1916-19; Ireland, 1920-22; M.C., 1919; asst. regis., titles, Tanganjika Territory, 1922; ag. regis., titles, in 1922, 1923, 1924 and 1925; ag. solr-gen. for various periods in 1922, 1923 and 1927-32; dep. land offr., Mar., 1926; crown coun., 1926; atty.-gen., Nyasaland Prot., 1933; ag. judge, Nov., 1933 to Dec., 1934; puisne just., Ceylon, 1936.

MOSELEY, HENRY DOYLE.—B. 1884; junior clk., sup. ct., W. Aust., Oct., 1900; judges' assoc. and clk. of arraigns, Aug., 1903.

MOTHERSILL, LAWRENCE JOHN.—B. 1899; ed. Bedford Schl. and R.M.C., Sandhurst; regular army, The Royal Scots, 1918-28; cadet, Gold Coast, 1929; asst. dist. commr., 1930.

MOTTISTONE, 1st Baron (cir. 1933), MAJOR-GEN. RT. HON. JOHN EDWARD BERNARD SEELY, P.C. (1909), C.B. (1916), C.M.G. (1918), D.S.O. (1900).—Ed. at Harrow and Trinity Coll., Cambridge; called to the bar, Inner Temple, 1897; lieut.-col. commdg. Hampshire Carabiniers; served with Imperial Yeomanry in S. Africa, 1900-1901 (deeps., Queen's medal, five clasps, D.S.O.); M.P. for Isle of Wight, 1900-06; M.P. for Abercromby div., Liverpool, 1906-1910; M.P., Ilkeston div., Derbyshire, 1910; recd. gold medal (French govt.) for saving life at sea, 1891; partly, under-sec.of state for the colonies, 1908; chmn. of comtee. to inquire into organisation of crownagnt's offices, 1908; under-sec. of state for war, 1911; sec. of state for war, 1912-14; joint partly, sec. to ministry of munitions, 1918; under-sec. of state for air, Jan., 1919.

MOUBRAY, GEORGE ALEXANDER DE CHAZAL DE.—B. 1888; ed. Loretto Schl., Manchester Univ. (civ. engnr.), Zurich Polytechnikun and Univ. (pure science); cadet, F.M.S., 1912; offr. cls. V, Jan., 1916; do., cls. IV, Dec., 1919; ag. priv. sec. to ch. sec., F.M.S., Aug., 1920; regis., titles and town planning admtr., Selangor, in addn., July, 1923; offr., cls. III, Dec., 1924; offr., cls. II, Dec., 1929; 1st mag., K. Lumpur, Aug., 1930; offr., cls. I B, dist. offr., L. Perak, Oct., 1933; do., Kinta, Feb., 1934; do., Lower Perak, Nov., 1934.

MOULDER, HUGH ARTHUR WILLIAM.—B. 1879; ent. Fiji civ. serv., 1910; acctnt. and clk., Gilbert and Ellice Is., Dec., 1915; seconded for serv. in Fiji, Apr., 1921; ag. audtr., Aug., 1921
to Apr., 1922; ag. treas., Apr., 1924; ag. res. commr., Sept. to Oct., 1925; treas. and coltr., cust., 1925; col. treas., Br. Honduras, Feb., 1928; mem., exec. and legis. couns.; dir. pub. offrs. guarantee fund.

MOUNTAIN, HAROLD GRIFFITHS, M. Inst., M.M.—B. 1887; ed. at King's Schil., Worcester, and Schl. of Mines, Camborne (1st cls. dip.); served R.E., tunnelling coys. and eng. stores dept., 1916-19; inspr., mines, Cyprus, Oct., 1925; ag. water engr., July-Oct., 1930; inspr., lab. and regsr., trade unions, Jan., 1933; sec. for mines, Gold Coast, 1934.

MUCHMORE, ALFRED, A.L.A.A.—B. 1893; Br. postal serv., 1912-1920; Civ. Serv. Rifles and R.A.F., 1914-19; acct., post and tel., Tanganyika territory, 1920; ast. treas., 1923; senr. ast. treas., 1931; ag. dep. treas., Apr., 1933 to Feb., 1934 and Feb., 1935.

MUDIE, NORMAN DAVID, M.A. (Edin.), Barrister-at-Law. Middle Temple—B. 1884; cadet S. Sttlmts., Dec., 1907; passed cadet, Jan., 1911; offr., cls. V., June, 1911; dep. regar., sup. ct., Malacca in addition, Aug., 1917; offr. assignee of debtors' estates for Malacca, Oct.-Dec., 1917; offr., cls. IV., Jan., 1918; supernumy. offr., cls. III., Nov., 1919; stamp and probate offr., Singapore, Apr., 1922; regar. and sheriff, sup. ct., Penang, 1924; D.P.P. in addn. to dep. regar. and ast. offr. assignee, Penang, Dec., 1924; dist. judge, Malacca, May, 1925; offr., cls. IB., Oct., 1927; dist. judge and 1st mag., Penang, Nov., 1928; judge, F.M.S., June, 1932; puii-ne judge, sup. ct., S.S., Feb., 1932; judge, Seremban, Apr., 1934.

MUIR, JOHN COCHRAN.—B. 1902; ed. Kilbarchan, Camphill & Allan Glena schls., Glasgow Univ. and West of Scotland Agrl. Coll.; B.Sc., (Agr.) N.D.A., N.D.D., post-grd. course, Imp. Coll. of Trop. Agr., Trinidad; ast. supt., agr., Gold Coast, 1925; senr. agrl. offr., Zanzibar, 1935.

MULHALL, JOHN ARCHIBALD.—B. 1899; on mly. serv., 1916; cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., Dec., 1921; attd. Kalutara kach., Jan., 1922; ditto, Puttalam kach., Nov., 1922; extra office ast., Badulla kach., Oct., 1923; office ast., ditto, Jan., 1924; office ast., Galle kach., June, 1925; ditto, Anuradhapura kach., May, 1927; addnl. ast. col. sec., Jan., 1928; ast. col. sec., May, 1928; sec. retrenchment comm., Apr., 1932; ast. ch. sec., Oct., 1933.

MULLER, JAN FREDERIK.—B. 1891; 3rd grade olk., dept. of agr., Union of S. Africa, 1909; 2nd grade olk., 1919; 1st grade clk., 1921; senr. clk., 1926; prin. clk., dept. of mines, 1928; 2nd grade ch. olk., do., 1932; 1st grade ch. olk., do., 1934; under sec., do., 1934.

MULLIN, JOHN, O.B.E. (1935), F.S.I.—B. 1878; ed. England and Wales; assayer, surveyor and mining engr.; mem., instit. of mining and metallurgy, England; cert. sworn land surv., B. Guiana, 1906; 3rd cls. offr. and survr., B. Guiana, 1908; warden, mining dist. and J.P., 1910; 1st cls. clk., dept. of lands and mines, 1911; ag. chief clk., 1911-12, 1913-14; 1st lieut., B. Guiana local forces, 1915; capt., 1918; seconded to govt. secretariat as conf. clk., 1916; chmn., canals polder, 1917-25; ch. clk., lands and mines dept., 1918; ch. clk. and ag. ast. D.P.W., 1919-20; ast. commr., lands and mines, 1922; mem. and sec., bd. of colonisation and development, 1926; ag. commr., lands and mines, chmn., local govt. bd. and mem., town council on various occasions; commr., land and mines, 1927; mem., exec. and leg. couns., 1929.

MULOCK, Rt. Hon. Sir WILLIAM, P.C. (1925) K.C.M.G. (1902), K.C., LL.D., M.A.—B. 1843 graduated at Toronto Univ., 1863; gold medal in modern languages; called to the Ontario bar, 1868; vice-chanc. of Toronto Univ. in 1881; sat in parlmt. 1882 to 1905, representing N. York; postmr.-gen. in Sir W. Laurier's govt., June, 1896; ch. just., exchequer div., high ct. of just., Ontario, 1905; ch. just., Ontario, 1923.

MUNRO, THOMAS AMBROSE VESPER.—B. 1883; harbour, Bahamas, 1st Sept., 1913; ag. marshal, admry. side, sup. ct., 1919.

MURDOCH, JAMES WILSON, M.B., Ch.B. (Aberdeen).—B. 1900; 2nd ast. med. asst., ment. hosp., T. Rambutan, F.M.S., Jan., 1928; med. supt., do., July, 1931.

MURISON, Sir JAMES WILLIAM, KT. BACH. (1919), B.A., LL.B., K.C.—B. 1872; ed. privately and at Trin. Hall, Camb.; senr. class. scholar, 1891; 1st div., 2nd cls. class. tripes, 1894; 3rd cls. law tripes, Part II., 1895; Latham English prize, 1895; B.A., LL.B., 1895; called to Bar, Middle Temple, Apr., 1896; devilled and practised at the Chancery Bar, 1896-1902; registr., E.A.P., Oct., 1902; town mag., Mombasa, Jan., 1904; 2nd ast. judge, H.B.M. ct. for Zanzibar, Apr., 1904; sen. ast. judge, Mar., 1905; ch. judge, Zanzibar, 20th Sept., 1914; mem., of ct. of appl. for Eastern Africa, 1905-1910, and from 1914 upon transfer of Zanzibar to C.O.; judge, sup. ct. of H.H. Sultan of Zanzibar from 1908; arbitrator in dispute between Zanzibar and E.A.P. govts. as to H.H. mainland properties, 1911; recd. thanks of S. of S. for conversion of applied Indian Acts into Zanzibar Decrees, 1917; judge prize ot. Zanzibar from 1914; passed govt. exam. in Hindustani, 1903, and in Swahili, 1904; exam. in Swahili to the Zanzibar Govt.; joint ed., Zanzibar Law Repts., 1868-1918; atty.-gen., S. Sttlmts., 1919; ag. col. sec., June, 1920 to May, 1921; ch. just., S. Sttlmts., July, 1925; ret., 1933; commr. to Palestine to inquire into Jewish-Arab riots, 1934; edited the Revised Laws of the S. Sttlmts., 1926; author of "Swahili Translations," 1911.

MURPHY, Hon. DENIS, B.A.—B. 1870; ed. Ottawa Univ.; B.A. 1892; called to the bar, 1896; elec. to provincial legis. British Columbia, 1900; judge of sup. ct., B. Columbia, 1909.

MURPHY, JOHN HOWARD BLACKWOOD.—B. 1895; Schl. of Physic, Trinity Coll., Dublin, 1913; R.A.M.C., Jan., 1915; India Office, Apr., 1919; A.D.C., Jubaland, Dec., 1919; dist. commr., Gosha, 1920; ditto, Choreh, 1922; ditto, Kitul, Ukambani, 1923; resigned, private affairs, 1926; re-apptd., commr., Somaliland, 1927; admin. offr., Kenya, 1930.

MURPHY, JOSEPH.—B. 1892; ed. Stokane Schl., Sligo; R.L.C., 1913-22; Jamaica constab., Apr., 1922; sub-inspr., Apr., 1926; 3rd cls. inspr., Apr., 1931; King's pol. med., 1926.

MURPHY, PHILIP PAIN, B.A., M.B., B.Ch., B.A.O. (Dublin)—B. 1910; ed. Trinity Coll., Dublin; Royal City of Dublin Hosp.; med. offr., Somaliland, Jan., 1935.

MURPHY, Hon. THOMAS GEROW, P.C. (Can.).—B. 1883; ed. at pub. and high schls. of Ont.; grad. of Man. Coll. Pharmacy; 1st cl. to H. of C., Canada, g. e., Oct., 1925; re-elec., g. e., 1930; min. of interior in Bennett admnstr., Aug. 1st, 1930; re-elec. by accl. after assuming office Aug., 1930.

MURPHY, TIMOTHY.—B. 1882; joined Hong Kong pol., Dec., 1903; passed final exam. in
Cantonese, 1912; inspr., Aug., 1922; King's pol. med., 1924 C.D.I., Nov., 1926; asst. supt., pol., July, 1931.

MURPHY, WILLIAM LINDSAY.—B.A., Trin. Coll., Dublin; B. 1887; cadet, Ceylon civ. ser., Nov., 1910; addl., Kandy kach., Dec., 1910; addtl. pol. mag., Colombo, Aug., 1911; ag. office asst. to govt. agt., Prov. of Sabaragamuwa, Jan., 1912; office asst. to govt., Prov. of Uva, May, 1913; asst. land settlmt. offr., July, 1913; ag. asst. govt. agt., Kandy, Feb., 1915; addtl. pol. mag. and addtl. mun. mag., Colombo, Apr., 1915; ag. asst. govt. agt., Mullaitivu, Oct., 1915; ditto, Hambantota, Nov., 1917; ditto, Matare, Oct., 1920; addnl. dist. judge, Galle, Jan., 1921; ag. asst. govt. agt., Kegalla, May, 1921; asst. govt. agt., Kandy, Sept., 1922; asst. govt. agt., Trincomalee, Apr., 1923; temp. employed, C.O., 1926; addnl. asst. col. sec., Jan., 1927; 2nd asst. col. sec. and clk., leg. coun., Feb., 1927; prin. asst. col. sec. and clk., exec. coun., May, 1928; comptlr., lab., Sept., 1931; chmn., munic. coun. and mayor, Colombo, Mar., 1932.

MURRAY, ARTHUR EVELYN FRANCIS, B.A. (Oxon.), Barrister.—B. 1888; ed. Marlborough and Exeter Coll., Oxford; asst. dis. comsrs., S. Nigeria, 1912; cls. I, grade I, admstv. serv., 1928; sec. to comsn. of inquiry into disturbances in S.E. Provs., 1930; ag. sec. for native affrs., 1930.

MURRAY, HON. SIR GEORGE JOHN ROBERT, K.C.M.G. (1917), B.A., LL.M.—B. 1863; judge of sup. ct., S. Australia, 1912; chief just., Jan., 1916 and lieut.-gov., Apr., 1916.

MURRAY, SIR J. H. P., K.C.M.G. (1925), C.M.G. (1914).—M.A., Oxon.; ed. at Sydney gram. schl. and won Knox prize, Fairfax prize, senr. univ. prize, and John West medal; went to Brighton Coll., Germany, and Univ. Coll., London; entd. Oxford Univ. and gained foundation scholarship to Magdalen Coll., 1880; 1st cls. class. mods., 1882; 1st cls. Lit., Hum., 1884; M.A., 1885; called to the bar, Inner Temple, 1886; practised as a barrister in Australia until apptd. crown prosecutor, N.S. Wales; acted as dist. ct. judge on several occasions; commanded N.S.W. Irish Rifles, 1898; served in S. African war, 1900-1901; recd. comsn. of major in Impl. army in recognition of his services, 1902; chief judicial offr. and mem. of exec. and legis. couns., Papua, Sept., 1904; ag. administr., 8th Apr., 1907; and lieut.-gov., in addition to duties of judge, 1908.

MURRAY, MENZIES.—B. 1890; ed. Stellenbosch and Trinity Coll., Dublin; B.A. (hons. Stellenbosch), 1920; B.A., LL.B. (T.C.D.), 1914; LL.B. (S.A.), 1920; war serv., 1914-19; capt., R.W. Fus., M.C.; advoc., 1921; ch. clk., patent office, Univ. of S. Africa, Jan., 1930; regsr., patents and regsr., companies, June 1932.

MURRAY, ROBERT EVERITT KING.—B. 1902; clk., grade II, Basutoland, 1924; sub.-inspr., Basutoland mounted pol., 1930.

MURRAY-JARDINE, ROBERT WILLIAM GORDON.—Ed. Marlborough Coll. and Clare Coll., Camb.; asst. dist. comsrs., Uganda, 1912; sec. commdr., 4th Batt. K.A.R., 1917-18; called to the bar (Inner Temple), 1919; dist. mag., Tanganyika Territory, 1919; ret. without taking up appt., 1920; dist. mag., Entebbe, Uganda, 1921; senr. mag., 1930.

MURTLAND, CHARLES CAMPBELL.—B. 1884; ed. Harrogate, York and Dublin; sub.-inspr. of police, B. Guiana, 1908; dist.-inspr., 1912; ag. county inspr., 1910-1911, 1914-1916; capt., B. Guiana militia, 1915; county inspr., 1920; detective inspr., 1927; ag. dep. inspr.-gen., pol., Sept., 1928 to May, 1929 and Apr.-Nov., 1930.

MYCOCK, CHARLES.—B. 1890; asst. mast., educn. dept., Hong Kong, Jan., 1915; asst. cable censor, 1914-16; on mily. serv., 1917-19; headmr. Ellis Kadoorie schl., 1919; do., Yaumati schl., 1928-30 and 1932-34; 2nd mastr., Queen's Coll., 1930.

MYERS, Rt. Hon. Sir MICHAEL, P.C (1931), K.C.M.G. (1930), K.C. (1922), LL.B. (1897).—B. 1873; ed. Thornton schl., Wellington Coll. and Canterbury Univ. Coll. (N.Z.); in legal practice many years; ch. just., N.Z., 1929.

NAIRAC, GEORGE EDOUARD, K.C.—B. 1876; ed. R. Coll., Mauritius; called to bar, 1898; ag. addnl. subst. procureur and advoc.-gen., 1903-06; mem. for Port Louis in coun. of govt., 1911-25; nominated mem., 1926; K.C., 1926; procureur and advoc.-gen., July, 1927; mem., exec. coun. and coun. of govt.; ag. col. sec., July, 1928 to Mar., 1929; ag. ch. just., Oct., 1929 to Oct., 1930; ch. judge, 1930; edr., Mauritius Law Repts. since 1906 and of the Law Repts. Digest, 1902-26.

NAISH, RICHARD BRYANT.—B. 1891; B.A. (Oxon.), M.R. San. I.; cadet, Ceylon civ. ser., Nov., 1914; attached to Galle kach., Dec., 1914; addtl. pol. mag., Galle in addn., Apr., 1915; extra office asst. to govt. agt., N. Prov., Oct., 1916; pol. mag., Gampola, Dec., 1918; asst. contr. of estate supplies, May, 1919; office asst. to govt. agt., C. Prov., Feb., 1920; addnl. pol. mag., Colombo, Negombo and Avissawella, Sept., 1920; asst. finan. asst. to chmn., mun. coun., Colombo, Jan., 1921; pol. mag., Pt. Pedro, Nov., 1921; asst. govt. agt., Batticaloa, Mar., 1923; ditto, Karunagala, Sept., 1925; asst. contr., rev., Mar., 1928; sec., univ. comsn. in addn., July, 1928; addnl. pol. mag., Colombo, Sept., 1931; dep. contr., lab., Oct., 1931; attchd., atty.-gen.'s dept. for sp. duty, May, 1934.

NANKIVELL, HOWARD.—B. 1853; ed. Christ's Hosp.; clk., col. secretariat, Jamaica, 1911; asst., 1912; 2nd cls. air mech., R.F.C., 1916; 2nd lieut., R.F.C., 1916; lieut. tech., R.A.F., 1917-1920; 2nd cls. clk., col. secretariat, Jamaica, 1917; 1st ditt., 1920; sec. salaries regrading comsn., 1922; sec., disturbances coman., 1922; sec. advisory finan. comtee., 1924; sec., civ. serv. comtee., 1925; prin. clk., secretariat, 1925; sec., prelim. W. I. confce., 1926; attd. for temp. duty, C.O., 1926; sec., salaries coman., Jamaica, 1928; ag. clk., privy coun., 1928; asst. col. sec., Trinidad, Apr., 1929; ag. col. sec., on various occasions, 1929-35; dep. col. sec. Jan., 1930; sec., intercol. confce. on trade relations with Canada, 1930; sec., Trinidad air bd., 1930; ag. gov.'s dep., Jan., 1932 and Aug., 1934; chmn., unemployment bd., 1935.

NAPIER, SIR WALTER JOHN, K.T. BACH. (1909), D.C.L. (Oxon.).—Barrister-at-law, Lincoln's Inn; atty.-gen., S. Sttlmts., 1907-1909; mem., W. African lands comtee., 1912.

NASH, HERBERT FREDERICK WILLIAM.—B. 1901; entered C.O., 26th Nov., 1917; apptd., after compet. exam., asst. clk. and assigned to C.O., 29th Dec., 1919; cler. offr., 1st Jan., 1920 higher cler. offr., 17th Sept., 1929.

NASH, WALTER.—B. 1890; ed. King's Coll., London; conf. clk. to gov.-gen., Nigeria, July, 1913; admstv. offr., 1918; res., 1932.

NASON, WILFRID PAUL.—B. 1894; ed. Christ's Hosp.; served with forces, France and
Russia, 1915-19; asst. audr., Tanganyika Territory; do., Nigeria, 1928; audr., Leeward Is., 1932; audr., Trinidad, 1925.

NATHAN, Lt.-Col. Sir Matthew, G.C.M.G. (1908), K.C.M.G. (1902), C.M.G. (1899).—B. 1862; entd. R.E., 1880; capt., 1889; maj., 1898; lt.-col., 1907; served in Nile expdn., 1885; Lushai expdn. (medal with clasp), 1889; sec. col. def. comtes., 1895; admnstr. govt. of S. Leone in 1899; gov., Gold Coast, Oct., 1900; gov., Hong Kong, 21st Sept., 1903; gov., Natal, 1st May, 1907; sec. to G.P.O., London, 1910; chrmn. of bd. of inland revenue, 1911; under sec. to lord-lieut. of Ireland, 1914; permanent sec. to ministry of pensions, 1916; gov., Queensland, 1920-25.

NATTRASS, Roland Marshall, B.Sc. (Agr.), Lond., Ph.D., Lond., D.I.C., Dip. Agr., Wye.—B. 1895; ed. Nottingham High Schl.; asst. to cotton specialist, Tanganyika Territory, 1922; advisory mycologist, Western Prov.; Bristol Univ., Long Ashton Research Statn., 1924; senr. mycologist, miny. of agr., Egypt, 1928; mycologist, Cyprus, 1931.

NATTRISS, Ernest Alfred, O.B.E. (1934).—B. 1882; ent. C.A. shipping agents, 1898; apptd. to C.A. office, 1912; dep. head, shipping dept., 1922; apptd. shipping offr. to the "Discovery Committee," 1927; head, shipping dept., 1933; do., gen. stores dept., 1935.

NAVARATNAM, Sahavanamuttu Samuel, B.Sc. (Lond.).—B. 1894; cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., Dec., 1921; attd., Matara Kach., Dec., 1921; ditto, Ratnapura Kach., May, 1922; extra office asst. to gov't. agt., Prov. of Sabaragamuwa, Sept., 1923; p.l. mag., Matale, May, 1924; ditto, Chilaw, Feb., 1926; asst. comsnr., excise, Aug., 1927; dist. judge, Kegalle, Mar., 1930; asst. attmlt. offr., July, 1931; sec. to min. of lab., industry and commerce, Oct., 1931; dep. contr., lab., Aug., 1933; asst. land comsnr., Dec., 1933; asst. settlmt. offr., June, 1934.

NEALE, Harold Bernard, I.S.O. (1935).—Second clk. to asst. comsnr., Southern div., Bech. Prot., June, 1909; 2nd clk. to asst. comsnr., Northern Prot.; passed Cape civ. ser. lower law exam., 1911; J.P., 1912; ag. asst. res. mag., 1913; sub-inspr., Bech. Prot. pol., 1914; ag. res. mag., 1914; granted local rank of capt.; res. mag., 1921; ag. govt. sec., 1933; govt. sec., 1934; ag. asst. res. comsnr., Mar.-Sept., 1935.

NEAVE, John Richard, M.C.—B. 1893; ed. King's Coll., Lond.; cadet, S.S., Oct., 1919; attd., res. office, Malacca, Nov., 1919; asst. advr., Kota Tinggi, Feb., 1925; res., Labuan, Dec., 1927; offr., cls. III, Jan., 1930; ag. comsnr., lands, Trengganu, July, 1931; 2nd ast. sec. (A), S.S., Dec., 1932; ag. asst. treas. and coltr., land rev., Malacca, Aug., 1933; offr. cls. II., Jan., 1935.

NEFF, Erroll Aubrey, M.D., L.C.P. & S. (Alberta), D.P.H.—B. 1887; ed. High Schl., Ingersoll, Ont., Toronto Univ. and Western Univ.; on war serv. with rank of major, 1914-19; dist. med. offr., Fiji, and med. supt., Cent. Leper Hosp., Makogai, Fiji, 1921; two Rockefeller foundation fellowships, 1926 and 1931; rep. S. Pacific cols. at Internat. Leprony Conf., Manila, 1931; senr. med. offr., Cyprus, Nov., 1934.

NEILLI, J. H.—Med. offr., E. Africa Prot., Mar., 1919; ditto, Uganda, July, 1920.

NEIL, William Hardley Edwin, F.R.G.S.—B. 1892; ed. Cathedral Schl., Winchester, Taunton's, Southampton and Hartley Univ. Coll., Extn., Southampton; war ser., Sept., 1914-Sept., 1919; survey probtnr., F.M.S., Nov., 1920; asst. supt., trig. surveys, Dec., 1923; ditto, topo. br., Dec., 1925; ditto, rev. surveys, Pahang, Jan., 1931; asst. supt., surveys, N. Kedah, Aug., 1932; senr. asst. supt., surveys, Malaya, 1935.

NEILL, James Scott, B.A., Barrister-at-Law.—B. 1889; ed. NUNN, MAJOR REGINALD LEWIS, D.S.O., M.Inst.C.E., M.Inst.W.E.—B.1892; ed. Brighton Coll.; waterwks. engrnr., Trinidad and Tobago, Apr., 1921; res. engrnr., Br. NUROCK, MAX, O.B.E. (1932), M.A. (Dublin)—B. 1893; mily. serv., 1915-19; asst. pvte. sec., Palestine, 1920; junr. asst. sec., 1922; asst. sec., 1926; sec. to standing comtee. for commerce and industry, 1928; ag. asst. ch. sec. on various occasions and once as ch. sec.; clk., exec. coun. in addn., 1934.

NUTMAN, FREDERICK JOHN, A.R.C.S., M.Sc., D.I.C.—B. 1904; ed. Newton Abbot and R. Coll. of Sci., Lond.; timber mycologist, forest products research lab., Oxford, 1926; plant physiologist, E. African agril. research sta., Amani, Tanganyika Territory, 1928.

OAKES, ARTHUR PODMORE, M.M., R. of O.—B. 1892; Europ. War, 1914-18; N. Staffordshire
Regt., 1912; Northamptonshire Regt., 1917-28; K.A.R., Nyassaland and Somaliland, 1921-26; pay and qrtmr. Somaliland pol., 1926; dep. comdt. pol. and dir., prisons, 1928.

OAKLEY, PHILIP DOUGLAS, M.R.C.S. (Eng.), L.R.C.P. (Lond.), D.T.M. (L'pool).—B. 1883; med. offr., W.A.M.S., Gold Coast, Jan., 1911; senr med. offr., July, 1928; ast. dir., med. serv., Aug., 1928; dep. dir., Feb., 1932; dir., med. and san. services, Sierra Leone, 1933.

O'BRIEN, ARTHUR JOHN RUSHTON, C.M.G. (1929), M.C., M.B., Ch.B. (Edin.), D.P.H., B.Hy. (hons.), (Durham), Certif. L.S.T.M.—B. 1883 joined W.A.M.S., 1911; served in Great War, 1915-19; awarded M.C. and bar, twice ment. in desp., and recvd. thanks of S. of S. for services in Cameroons; surg. specialist, Gold Coast, 1921; R.M.O., Gold Coast hospital, 1923; sec. to C.A.M.S. comte., Dec., 1929; visited West Indies at request of S. of S., 1930; assumed duty as sec., C.A.M.S., comte., June, 1930.

O'BRIEN, BYAN JUSTIN.—B. 1902; ed. Uppingham and Queen's Coll., Oxford; 1st cls. hon. mods.; 2nd cls. lit. hum.; ast. sec., col. sec.'s office, Cyprus, Apr., 1927, ag. clk., exec. coun., for various periods, 1927-31; clk., exec. coun., Aug., 1931; ag. ch. ast. sec. for various periods, 1927-36; ag. ast. comanr., Jan. to Mar., 1928; ag. col. sec., Dec., 1933; joint edr., Handbook of Cyprus, 1930 edn.

O'CONNOR, ALEXANDER JAMES, Dipl. Forestry (Capo).—Clik., conserv. of forest's office, W. conservancy, 1903; forester, Uitvlugt, W. conservancy, 1905; ast. dist. forest offr., Tokai, 1908; seconded to gen. comm., Transkei, 1908; ast. dist. forest offr., Knysna, 1909; ditto, working plans, Midland conservancy, 1910; ditto, Woodbush, Transvaal conservancy, 1910; dist. forest offr., Woodbush, 1918; ditto, Pietersburg, 1924; ag. conserv., forests, Natal conservancy, 1926; 2nd grade conserv. of forests, Natal conservancy, 1927; prin. forest offr. O'CONNOR, CHARLES ANTHONY.—B. 1883; ed. O'CONNOR, HUGH JOSEPH, F.Z.S.—B. 1887; Lieut., Gambia Artillery (V.), 1910; mem. of navigation and pilotage board, Gambia, 1914; ast. commnr. of police, G. O'CONNOR, JOSEPH.—B. 1896; ed. O'DONOGHUE, LAURENCE.—B. 1895; ed. Newcastle Schl., Co Tipperary; R.I.C., 1917-22; staff sergt.-major, Jamaica constab., Feb., 1922; sub-inspr., Feb., 1931; 3rd cls. inspr., Nov., 1932.

O'FARRELL, EDWARD JOSEPH.—Ed. Belvedere Coll., and Trinity Coll., Dublin; solr., supt. et., Ireland, 1905; dep. regisr., sup. ct., Kenya, 1924; dep. offi. recr. for Coast Prov. and ex-officio agt. at Mompassa for pub. trustee, Kenya, 1930.

OGG, ROBERT CUTHBERT, M.B., Ch.B.—B. 1901; rel. med. offr., Basutoland, 1927; med. offr., 1929.

OGILVIE, J.—B. 1886; ed. Fordyce Acad., Banffshire and Robert Gordon's Coll., Aberdeen; war serv., 1914-19; ast. engrnr., Nigerian rly., 1919; divil. engrnr., 1923.

O'GRADY, WILLIAM MICHAEL, B.L.—B. 1886; ed. Wesley Coll., Dublin, admitted solr., Ireland, 1908; mily. serv., Egypt, 1916; Salonika, 1916-17; Palestine, 1917-18; Egypt, 1919; called to bar, Ireland, 1920; mag., Tanganyika Territory, 1920; ag. puisne judge, high ct., on various occasions, 1927, 1932 and 1934-35.

OKE, HARRIS RENDELL, M.C.—B. 1891; ed. Bishop Field Coll., St. John's, Newfoundland; studt. at law, 1909-14; The Royal Newfoundland Regt., 1914-15; The Royal Scots, 1915-20; served France, 1916-18 (M.C. and ment. in desps., 1918); served N. Russian Relief Force, 1919 (bar to M.C.); admstve. offr., Nigeria, 1920; transf'd. to admstve. serv., the Gambia, 1932; ag. col. sec., May-Aug. and Dec., 1933; ag. gov., Jan.-Apr., 1934; senr. ast. col. sec., Apr., 1934; col. sec., 1934; ag. gov., May-Oct., 1935.

OLDFIELD, H. G.—Tempy. ast. dist. comanr., E. Africa Prot., June, 1919.

OLIPHANT, JOHN NINIAN, M.B.E.—B. 1887; ed. Glenalmond Coll. and Christ Ch., Oxford, B.A. and dipl. forestry, 1909; imp. forest service, India, 1909-23; dep. conservator, forests, Br. Honduras, Dec., 1923; conservator, forests, 1924; dep. dir., forestry, F.M.S. and S.S., 1929; ag. dir. forestry, F.M.S. and S.S. in 1931 and 1934.

OLIVER, GEO. A.—B. 1898; ent. G.P.O., Dec., 1914; apptd. ast. clk., Apr., 1916; wireless operator, R.N.V.R., Jan., 1917 to Apr., 1919; cler. offr., 1st Jan., 1920; transf'd. to C.O., June, 1923; accompanied U.K. delegation to Imp. Economic Conf., Ottawa, 1932.

OLIVER, WALTER REGINALD BROCK, D.Sc., F.R. Soc. N.Z.—B. 1893; ed. Tauranga High Schl. and Victoria Univ. Coll., N.Z.; ent. N.Z. cust. dept., 1900; Dom. museum staff, 1920; dir., 1928.

OLIVIER, 1ST BARON (created 1924), Rt. Hon. SIR SYDNEY OLIVIER, P.C. (1924), K.C.M.G. (1907), C.M.G. (1938), B.A.—B. 1859; ed. at Tombridge schl.; open exhibnr., Corpus Christi Coll., Oxford; 2nd class classical mods., 1878; 2nd class in final classical schl., 1881; apptd., after compet. exam., clk. in the office of the S. of S. for cols., 17th Apr., 1882; honourably mentioned for Cobden prize essay, Oxford, 1883; ag. col. sec., Br. Honduras, Oct., 1890, to Apr., 1891; ag. auditor-gen., Leeward Is., Oct., 1896, to Feb., 1896; priv. sec. to the Earl of Selborne, Sept., 1896; sec. to the Roy. comm. to inquire into condition of W. Indies, Dec., 1896; 1st class clk., June, 1897; sent to Washington on sp. serv. in connect. with W. Indian reciprocity negotiations, 1898; col. sec., Jamaica, 1900-1904; ag. gov., 1900, 1902, and 1904; returned to C.O. as a prin. clk., Oct., 1904; gov. of Jamaica, Apr., 1907; assumed gov't., May, 1907; represented West Indian Colonies at the Coronation of H.M. King George V., 1911; perm. sec., bd. of agriculture and fisheries, 1913; mem. of comte., for settm. of ex-service
men within the Empire, 1917; asst. comptr. and audr., exchequer and audit dept., 1917; S. of S. for India, 23rd Jan. to 7th Nov., 1924.

O'MORCHOE, THE (Capt. ARTHUR DONALD MACMURROGH).—B. 1892; ed. St. Andrew's Coll. and Trinity Coll., Dublin; joined Leinster Regt. (Royal Meaths), Aug., 1914; served in the great war; regt. signalling offr., 1915; asst. adjt., 1916-17; A.D.C. to maj. gen. Hon. E. J. Montague Stuart-Wortley and camp commdt., 65th divn., 1917-18; provost marshal's dept., 1918-22; junr. pol. offr., Zanzibar, Jan., 1924; pub. pros., 1924-25; supt., pol., Feb., 1926; ag. asupt., C.I.D., Nov., 1925 to May, 1926; adjt., 1928; ag. asst. commdt., 1930; A.D.C. to Br. res., Aug., 1930; pvt. sec., May, 1931; comsrr., pol., Gold Coast, 1934.

ONRAET, RENE HENRY DE SOLMINIHAC.—B. 1887; pol. prob., S. Sttlmts., Dec., 1907; passed final exam. in Hokkien, July, 1910; passed final exam. in Malay, Aug., 1911; asst. supt. of pol., July, 1912; ag. supt. of pol., Singapore, Jan., 1919; asst supt. of pol., Singapore, Mar., 1919; supt. pol. and dir. crim. intell., S.S., Mar., 1922; ch. pol. offr., S'pore, Dec., 1925, and June 1931; dir., crim. intell., S.S., Oct., 1926; dep. comsrr. pol., Perak, F.M.S., Oct., 1931; ag. inspr. gen. pol., S.S., Mar., 1932; ch. pol. offr., Perak, Oct., 1933; inspr.-gen., pol., S'pore, 1935.

OORLOOF, CEDRIC JAMES, B.A. (Lond.).—B. 1906; cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., Oct., 1930; attd., secretariat, Oct., 1930; attd., Kalutara kach., July, 1931; office asst., Hambantota Kach., Oct., 1932.

O'REILLY, HARRY ALLAN OSWALD.—B. 1893; called to bar, Lincoln's Inn, 1924 (cert. of hon.); dep. regier. gen., Trinidad, 1934.

O'REILLY, JAMES GALLUS.—B. 1883; ed. Sembilan, Feb., 1932; ditto, Perak, Nov., 1932; do., Selangor and Pahang, Oct., 1933; asst. supt., govt. monops., S.S., Penang, Nov., 1934.

ORMSBY-GORE, RT. HON. WILLIAM GEORGE ARTHUR, P.C. (1927).—B. 1885; ed. Eton and New Coll., Oxford (B.A.); late capt., Shropshire Yeomany; intell. officer Arab bureau, 1916-17; asst. sec., War Cabinet, 1917-18; asst. polit. offr., Palestine, 1918; British mem., Permanent Mandates Coms., League of Nations, 1921-22; M.P., Stafford since Jan., 1910; accompanied C.O. mission to British West Indies, 1921-22; partly under sec. of state for Colonies, 1st Nov., 1922 to 23rd Jan., 1924 and since Nov., 1924; chmn., partly, coms. to E. Africa, 1924; apptd. by S. of S. to visit and rept. on W. African dependencies, Jan., 1926.

ORR, SIR CHARLES WILLIAM JAMES, K.C.M.G. (1928), C.M.G. (1921).—B. 1870; ed. Bath Coll. and Woolwich Acad.; 1st comn., Royal Artillery, Feb., 1889; capt., Sept., 1899; maj., 1904; ret., Sept., 1908, served with Chitral relief force, 1895 (medal with clasp); Indian frontier, 1897 (clasp); Tirah expdn. force, 1897-99 (clasp); China war, 1900-01 (medal); S. W.O., Int. branch, 1918-19; col. sec., Gibraltar, June, 1919; ag. gov., on several occasions; gov. and commdr.-in-ch. of the Bahamas, 1926-1931; ret.

ORR, LIONEL ALEXANDER WILLIAM.—B. 1905; ed. St. Andrew's Coll., Dublin and Trinity Coll., Dublin, B.A., LL.B.; solr., sup. ct., I.F.S.; asst. compt., lands, Gold Coast, Aug., 1929 to Aug., 1932; asst. admistr.-gen., N. OSBORNE, MAJOR D. R.—B. 1879; ed. Prince Alfred Coll., Adelaide, S. Australia, Adelaide Univ. (mental and moral phil.) and Christ's Coll., Cambridge; B.A., law; called to the bar, Inner Temple, 1909; practiced at bar until 1914; on mily. serv., 1914-19; st. martial offr., Nov., 1918 to May, 1920; in Ireland as A.L.O. until Apr., 1922; stip. and circuit mag., Bahamas, June, 1923; ag. ch. just., Aug. to Sept., 1923 and from July to Nov., 1924; ag. reg.-gen. in addn. June to July, 1924.

OSTLER, HON. HENRY HUBERT, K.C. (1925), LL.B. (1904).—B. 1876; ed. Christ's Hosp. and Victoria Univ. Coll.; assoc. to New Zealand ch. just., 1903-06; edr. N.Z. Law Repts., 1906-10; 1st asst., crown law office and crown pros., 1910; ag. solr.-gen., 1913; in private practice, 1915-25; judge, N.Z. sup. ct., 1926; examr. in law for N.Z. Univ. for many years; fellow N.Z. Univ. senate, 1916-20.

O'SULLIVAN, TIMOTHY ADOLPHUS, M.A., M.R.S.T.—B. 1894; ed. King's Hosp. and Trinity coll., Dublin; asst. mast., col. for blind, Worcester, St. Christopher's, Eastbourne, Ranelagh sch., Athlone, 1913-15; Inns Ct. O.T.C. and R.A., 1915-19; asst. mast., Raffles inst., Singapore, 1919; inspr., schls., Pahang, Feb., 1922; do., Malacca, Nov., 1924; do., Selangor, Nov., 1924; senr. educn. offr. (A.), S.S., 1931; inspr., schls., Penang, Nov., 1931.

OSWELL, HENRY THEODORE WARREN.—B. 1896; ed. Dulwich Coll. and Worcester Coll., Oxford; war serv., 1915-18; cadet, F.M.S., April, 1920; passed cadet, June, 1922; offr., class V, Apr., 1923; asst. dist. offr., T. Malim, Feb., 1925; asst. contrlr., lab., Seremban, Aug., 1925; offr., cls. IV, Apr., 1927; dist. offr., Ulu Langat, Nov., 1929; prot., lab., Kedah, Mar., 1930; offr., cls. III, Apr., 1932.

OTWAY, J. H., O.B.E. OWEN, ALBERT EDWARD.—Asst. acct. N. Rhodesia, Oct., 1915; attd., lands dept., Oct., 1915 to May, 1922; treasy., May, 1922; ch. clk., dept., agr., Jan., 1927; treasy., Apr., 1930; ag. dep. treas., in 1928, 1929 and 1931; contr., stores and transport, Dec., 1932.

OWEN, A. H., B.A. (Camb.), M.R.C.S. (Eng.), L.R.C.P. (Lond.), D.T.M. and H. (Camb.), Cert. of S.T.M. (Lond.)—Med. offr., Uganda, Oct.,

Guiana, Feb., 1925; ag. col. sec. on various occasions, 1925-30; col. sec., Barbados, Sept., 1931; ag. gov. in 1932, 1933 and 1935.

OWEN, GEORGE HUMPHREY RICHARD ST. JOHN.—Cadet, Tanganyika Territory, 1920; 2nd grade admstr. offr., July, 1922; seconded to C.O. as ast. prin., Feb. to Aug., 1929; dist. offr., Tanganyika Territory, July, 1931; ag. ast. admstr.-gen., 1933.

OWEN, HAROLD ALBERT.—B. 1892; entd. crown agt.'s office, Dec., 1911; seconded as 3rd clk., col. sec.'s office, Antigua, July, 1916; sec. to comm. of enquiry into condition of St. John's fire brigade, Nov., 1916; returned to crown agt.'s office, Sept., 1919.

OWEN, JOHN HENRY, D.S.C. (1917).—Younger brother, Trinity House, London; master mariner; ed. Univ. Coll. Schol., London and H.M.S. OWEN, WILFRED HERBERT, B.Sc.Tech., A.R.I.B.A., Chart. Aroh.—B. 1896; ed. St. John's, Cheetham, Manchester, Manchester Gram- mar Schol. and Manchester Univ.; archt., P.W.D., Hong Kong, 1925.

Nigeria, 1911; rev. mission to Anglo-Egyptian Sudan, 1912; supervisor, native rev., Nigeria, 1914; ag. res., Kano Prov., Nigeria, 1915-16; res., Bornu Prov., Nigeria, 1917; visited Anglo-Egyptian Sudan from Bornu via Wadai and Darfur in connection with educn. proposals, 1918; ag. lieut.-gov., N.
